subject.title: [Feature]: Control console session list should show full date

question: Should the Sessions Updated column switch from relative text to full local date/time as the primary value?
rationale: The code change is small, but this is a visible Control UI display policy choice and an open linked implementation PR already exists but is not directly merge-ready.

options.title: Adopt full date/time
options.body: Approve the requested UX direction and land a rebased same-repo implementation or replacement with localized fallback and browser proof.

options.title: Keep relative-first display
options.body: Keep the current relative Updated value and close or re-scope the request if exact timestamps should stay secondary.

options.title: Choose a hybrid display
options.body: Use full date/time in tooltip/details or a responsive secondary line instead of making it the primary table value.

recommendation.title: Adopt full date/time
recommendation.body: Approve the requested UX direction and land a rebased same-repo implementation or replacement with localized fallback and browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history across the Sessions view and Control UI render/test surface.
